create.name: Noah Mazé
create.bio:
Noah Mazé is a yoga teacher and trainer of teachers, known for precise, methodical classes that bring careful alignment together with flowing vinyasa, breathwork and meditation. He grew up meditating with his family, starting at four and including stays at Siddha Yoga ashrams in New York and India, began a regular asana practice at fourteen, and went on to study, and qualify in, most of the well-known modern postural lineages, Anusara among them.

With his wife Tracy he founded the school now called The Mazé Method, which runs Yoga Alliance registered 200- and 300-hour trainings online, plus 50-hour modules on anatomy, sequencing, vinyasa krama and yoga philosophy, where he treats the Bhagavad Gita, mythology and the history of the tradition as study rather than belief. After roughly ten years teaching on the early streaming site yogaglo, the couple started their own platform, mazeONyoga, and he has also taught for Yoga International, Omstars and Wanderlust TV and at the Esalen Institute. Alongside the online school he travels to lead weekend intensives in studios and retreats such as The Sacred Pause at the Sivananda ashram in the Bahamas, and his strength-focused classes are part of the Commune membership.

courses.title: Online 200-Hour Teacher Training with Nichol Chase & Noah Mazé
courses.description: A self-paced, Yoga Alliance registered foundation training taught with Nichol Chase, covering asana, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, sequencing, philosophy and teaching skills. It is open both to people who want to teach and to students who want to deepen their own practice.

courses.title: 300-Hour Teacher Training with Noah Mazé (2027 cohort)
courses.description: A year-long advanced online training for qualified teachers, built from six modules of roughly fifty to sixty hours each with live sessions, bonus classes and optional assignments. It asks teachers to examine why they teach as they do and to build their own curriculum with confidence.

courses.title: 300-Hour Teacher Training with Noah Mazé (self-paced)
courses.description: The same six-module advanced training, taken at your own pace from the recorded material, for teachers working towards a 500-hour credential. Payment plans are offered.

courses.title: Embodied Philosophy: Immersion & Practice Intensive
courses.description: A 50-hour module on the history, philosophy and mythology of yoga and on bringing themes into a class without oversimplifying them. It is taught as education rather than doctrine, and counts towards continuing education and the 300-hour certificate.

courses.title: Asanatomy: The Wonder of Your Body
courses.description: A 50-hour module on anatomy, kinesiology and biomechanics, worked through region by region in lectures and movement labs. It is aimed at teachers and keen students who want to understand how the body moves in practice.

courses.title: Vinyasa Krama: Teaching & Practice Intensive
courses.description: A 50-hour online module on teaching flow yoga: pose analysis, breath-led movement and strategies for sequencing. Access does not expire and the hours count towards continuing education.

courses.title: Asanatomy Four Part Weekend with Noah Mazé (Rancho Cucamonga)
courses.description: Two days of anatomy lectures and movement labs in Rancho Cucamonga, California, for teachers and students who have completed a 200-hour training. The four units can be booked singly or as a full weekend.

courses.title: Calm in the Storm with Noah Mazé (Gunnison)
courses.description: A weekend of three sessions at Dragon Asana in Gunnison, Colorado, on cultivating steadiness through asana, breath, meditation and philosophy. Come for one session or the whole weekend.

courses.title: The Sacred Pause Retreat
courses.description: A four-day retreat at the Sivananda Ashram on Paradise Island in the Bahamas, built around stories and teachings from the Bhagavad Gita and the Mahabharata. Mornings combine a philosophical theme, meditation and alignment-based practice, with quieter afternoons.

courses.title: Yoga Strong: Back to School Series
courses.description: A short series of three recorded online classes focused on strength, stability and control across the full range of yoga poses, with centring and mindful attention at the start of each class.
